full_prompt_en: A square narrative oil painting shows a thoughtful boy seated outside a cottage while a white dog waits beside him, all in warm greens and earthy browns. The old wall rises behind them, with red brick at the left, weathered plaster near the center, and climbing leaves spreading around a dark wooden doorway. The boy sits on the stone step just right of center, one elbow resting on a raised knee and his cheek in his hand. His short brown hair and distant expression are clearly modeled, while a dark green coat, tan trousers, and worn brown boots define his relaxed posture. At the lower left, the shaggy white dog sits facing him, its cream-tinted coat standing out against the shadowed masonry and foliage. Irregular paving slabs extend across the foreground, dotted with dry leaves and little patches of grass. A low stone post and a container of plants mark the left edge, and small flowers soften the area around the doorstep. The door behind the boy is partly open or deeply recessed, leaving a dark rectangular opening above his shoulder. Fine strokes describe the boy's face, the dog's head, and the nearby leaves, while broader blended strokes make the wall and background plants recede. Warm daylight falls from the upper left, catching the dog's back and the boy's face and boots; the doorway and dense foliage hold the deepest shadows. Muted olive, brick red, ocher, and cream repeat across clothing, stone, and vegetation without strong artificial color. The overall composition makes a quiet pause feel intimate through the close placement of the two figures and the richly observed cottage setting.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形叙事性油画描绘一名沉思的少年坐在小屋外，一只白狗在旁等待，整体以温暖的绿色和土褐色呈现。老墙在他们身后升起，左侧是红砖，中央附近是风化灰泥，攀缘叶片围绕深色木门展开。少年坐在中央偏右的石阶上，一只手肘搁在抬起的膝盖，脸颊倚在手中。短棕发和出神表情被清楚塑造，深绿色外套、棕黄色裤子和磨旧棕靴界定他放松的姿势。左下方，蓬松白狗坐着面向他，带奶油色的毛从阴影中的石墙和叶丛前凸显。前景铺着不规则石板，点缀干叶和小片草。低矮石柱与盛有植物的容器标记左缘，小花柔化门阶周围。少年身后的门半开或深深内凹，在肩上方留下一块深色矩形开口。细笔触描绘少年面部、狗头与近处叶片，较宽且融合的笔触使墙面和后方植物退远。暖日光从左上方落下，照亮狗背、少年面容和靴子；门洞与密叶留住最深的阴影。柔和的橄榄绿、砖红、赭黄和奶油色在衣服、石面和植被间重复，没有强烈的人造色。整体构图借两名主体的亲近位置与细致观察的小屋环境，使安静的停顿显得亲密。
style_prompt_en: The image has a traditional narrative oil-painting finish, with careful naturalistic modeling embedded in softly varied, visible brushwork. Olive and moss greens, brick red, warm umber, ocher, and cream form a subdued palette; a pale focal mass stands out against deeper surrounding tones. The closest forms carry fine strokes and precise expressions, while background surfaces merge through broader, more broken marks. Edges vary between clean contact points and soft transitions into foliage-like texture, giving the scene depth without hard graphic separation. Warm daylight glances across raised planes, and recessed areas hold rich brown-green shadow. Small irregular details gather around the lower margins, while a large dark opening and an uneven vertical backdrop anchor the upper field. The overall effect is observant, intimate, and gently nostalgic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有传统叙事油画的完成质感，细致自然的塑形融入柔和变化且可见的笔触。橄榄与苔绿色、砖红、暖褐、赭黄和奶油色构成低调色域；一团浅色焦点形体从较深的周围色调中凸显。近处形态带有细笔触和准确表情，背景表面则通过较宽、更断续的笔画融合。边缘在清楚接触点与融入叶状肌理的柔和过渡之间变化，让画面具有纵深而无需硬性的平面分隔。暖日光掠过凸起平面，凹处留有浓厚的棕绿阴影。细小不规则细节聚集在下缘，大块深色开口和不均匀的竖向背景则稳住上部。整体效果善于观察、亲密且轻带怀旧感。
theme_en: A thoughtful boy and a white dog outside a cottage
theme_zh: 小屋外沉思的少年与白狗
name: James Wells Champney
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
